frames.detail: Read the objective, identify supplies and choose your route. Native first-person view with the revised HUD.
frames.title: 01 / Campus after hours

frames.detail: The opening begins unarmed. Look for the emergency pistol case in Reception.
frames.title: 02 / Recover the emergency pistol

frames.detail: Open the Reception supply cache and recover the Main Breaker Fuse. Collecting it lets infected encounters start.
frames.title: 03 / Recover the breaker fuse

frames.detail: The marked case opens and equips the Benelli M4. Pistol magazines and 12-gauge shells replenish different reserves.
frames.title: 04 / Open the weapons case

frames.detail: A walker closes in. Create distance, then fire. The selected enemy runs its normal AI and takes damage from real weapon traces.
frames.title: 05 / First contact

frames.detail: Cross to the glazed entrance and recover the second component for the Security Substation.
frames.title: 06 / Recover the control relay

frames.detail: Spend recovered scrap on a real upgrade. Objective and kill XP improve rank and medkit effectiveness; rewards are saved once.
frames.title: 07 / Build your survivor

frames.detail: Install the fuse and relay separately. Both slots must be filled before the grid comes back online.
frames.title: 08 / Bring the grid online

frames.detail: Speak with the survivor after restoring power. Dialogue owns input and pauses threats; the journal explains the final route.
frames.title: 09 / Shaun's escape plan

frames.detail: The brute uses a distinct health bar, slower committed attacks and a readable windup. Move out of its contact range during the attack.
frames.title: 10 / Clear the courtyard

frames.detail: Boarding shifts to the truck camera. Drive along the opening and clear the gate.
frames.title: 11 / Take the wheel

frames.detail: Once the truck clears the gate, the debrief shows active playtime, infected defeated and damage dealt.
frames.title: 12 / Extraction and debrief

method: Script-assisted native gameplay: physical movement/combat and real interaction callbacks; safe repositioning between distant chapters; other enemies temporarily held for reproducibility.
